mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the past two months signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2%) and rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.1%) indicate a labor market and monetary policy mismatch, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 0.2% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes, a decline in industrial production signals reduced manufacturing output and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during supply shocks when INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 24-month rolling window.
